controls.name: Command Construction Safety
controls.description: Prevent unsafe executable command construction from untrusted tool arguments.

controls.name: Return-Path Content Sanitization
controls.description: Treat tool output as untrusted content and inspect it before model-context entry.

controls.name: Least-Privilege Tool Exposure
controls.description: Expose only explicitly authorized tools and resources to each verified principal.

controls.name: Server and Binary Integrity
controls.description: Verify local binaries before spawn and remote endpoint identity before protected use.

controls.name: Tool Invocation Audit
controls.description: Emit attributable and independently reconstructable evidence for protected tool invocations.

controls.name: Input Validation
controls.description: Validate tool input against the authorized schema and policy before dispatch.

controls.name: Trust Establishment
controls.description: Establish a verified principal and policy context before protected tool use.

controls.name: Economic Ceiling
controls.description: Attribute consumption to a principal and fail closed at the authorized ceiling.

controls.name: Secret Boundary
controls.description: Keep secrets out of model context, untrusted output, arguments, and inappropriate logs.

controls.name: Delegation Edge Monitoring
controls.description: Preserve originating delegation lineage across agent-to-tool actions.

controls.name: Catalog Provenance
controls.description: Compare catalogs against an authorized provenance baseline at trust establishment and revalidation.

controls.name: Principal-Scoped State
controls.description: Bind durable or handle-scoped state to the verified principal and policy context.

controls.name: Revocation and Reauthorization
controls.description: Invalidate prior authorization after revocation or material policy change without relying on a transport session boundary.

controls.name: Extension Capability Negotiation
controls.description: Permit extensions only when included in the principal capability grant and recorded at trust establishment.

controls.name: Header Body Assertion Integrity
controls.description: Reject disagreement between Mcp-Method or Mcp-Name headers and the JSON-RPC body before dispatch.

controls.name: State Handle Binding and Lifecycle
controls.description: Require unguessable, expiring, principal-bound state handles and never treat possession alone as identity.

controls.name: MRTR Round-Trip Integrity
controls.description: Bind model-mediated tool responses to the originating request and reject replay or mismatched responses.

controls.name: Catalog Cache Integrity
controls.description: Bound cache TTLs, bind cache keys to trust context, and detect catalog or schema provenance drift during revalidation.

controls.name: Authorization Chain Integrity
controls.description: Validate issuer, intended resource or audience, authorization metadata, redirect or resource binding, and SSRF boundaries before protected state change.
